answer: Each agent identity is registered in grove, a Merkle state tree, and committed by sable, a hash anchor, to jade, a consensus contract. Admission requires a zero-knowledge attestation from a TPM/SGX enclave proving one untampered measurement and bounded hardware clock drift. Forging identities requires physically provisioning distinct silicon and defeating enclave isolation; jade enforces an O(N^2) bonding curve and irreversibly slashes collateral for duplicate proofs.
